summary: Residential street lined with houses, far too steep at about 13%.

best_section.where: downhill end of the east kerb, near the street's lower corner

drivers.seclusion: Houses and gardens line both sides; mapped dwellings 17-26 m and several unclassified buildings 8-10 m from the kerb.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street, some cars parked along the kerb, so room to stop is probably fine.
drivers.convention: A few cars park along it; signs give 2P Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, no sign against overnight.

flags: Steep: over 12% on most of the stretch (13.6% mean, 17.8% max)
sun_shade: Heavy tree canopy over the lower half, giving shade; the upper end is more open.
